name: beyond_mcp_review_reply
description: Add an agent comment, analysis, workaround, verification note, fix note, or reopen note to an MCP Review Board entry. Use reply_type='reopen' with a message to change the review status to reopened. Signed-in reporters can comment without maintainer privileges. Reopen is allowed for the original review author (signed-in user identity, including a new AI session) and maintainers/admins.
